deploy_bundleInstructions:
This bundle contains private configuration. Transfer it securely and restrict access.
1. Copy {file} to Linux using removable media, a private network or scp.
2. Install Docker/Podman with compose, tar, sha256sum and sh. Load middleware images using docker load/podman load with the exact tags below.
3. Create a private release directory: mkdir -p release && chmod 700 release
4. From the bundle directory run tar -xf {file} -C release
5. Run cd release && sh {start}. Set HAI_DEPLOY_PROVIDER_REMOTE_RUNTIME=docker or podman to select the runtime explicitly.
6. Check compose ps / compose logs, Web and /health after startup. Bundle generation does not perform server health checks.
Required images (app/web are included; prepare middleware separately):
{images}
Built images can be reused across environments; this bundle contains configuration for the selected environment only.
deploy_bundleOnlyContainer: Compose bundle generation is supported only by docker-ssh.
